### Context

Turning off the later step that sets the default theme kept dark mode after refresh. Nothing was blocked.

### What is broken

Refreshing the account page switches a saved dark theme back to light. It should stay dark.

### Why it is broken

Two steps set the theme. The page first loads your saved choice, dark, from your stored account settings. A separate step that applies the default theme runs afterward and replaces it with light.

### How to fix it

Skip the default-theme step once a saved theme has loaded, so a refresh keeps dark. This is a small change to one step. Choose hotfix because the change is small and contained, and a repeat of the failing refresh can confirm it stays fixed.

gauntlet: gate=chase-bug/verdict-menu recommended=3

### What is broken

Refreshing the account page resets the saved dark theme to light.

### Why it is broken

Two parts of the page set the theme: the profile loader applies the saved `"dark"` value, then the default-theme initializer overwrites it with `"light"` (`src/profile-theme.ts:62`). The local test `node --test test/profile-theme.test.mjs` reproduces the reset; disabling the later initializer keeps dark, supporting the overwrite as the cause.

### How to fix it

Skip default initialization after a saved theme has loaded so refresh retains dark. This is a small, bounded change to the initializer, with the existing local test covering the failure. Choose hotfix because the fix is small and all six eligibility predicates pass.
